text:
```yaml
name: E2E Docs

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  e2e-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run E2E tests
        run: npm test -- --watchAll=false --testPathPattern='**/*e2e.test.ts'

      - name: Build documentation
        run: npm run docs:build

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: e2e-docs
          path: docs/build
```
